questions.question: If Chan weighs 68 kilograms, which of the following can be the possible weight of Dolly (in kilograms)?
questions.questionHtml: If Chan weighs 68 kilograms, which of the following can be the possible weight of Dolly (in kilograms)?
questions.solution:
Given:

So, possible odd numbers between 68 and 80 are:

69, 71, 73, 75, 77, 79

Among these, all satisfy the condition. So, any one of these can be Dolly's weight.

Therefore, weight of Dolly is 71 kg.

questions.question: Statements: All girls are honest. Priya is honest. Conclusion 1: Priya is a girl. Conclusion 2: All honest people are girls.
questions.questionHtml:
Statements: All girls are honest.

Priya is honest.

Conclusion 1: Priya is a girl.

Conclusion 2: All honest people are girls.
questions.solution:
Explanation:

Statement: "All girls are honest" → This means every girl is honest, but does not imply that only girls are honest.

Statement: "Priya is honest" → This tells us Priya belongs to the group of honest people, but it does not confirm whether Priya is a girl.

Therefore, none of the conclusions follow.
